newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin $113/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle sales thin $113/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Thursday were slow at $113.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with sales earlier this week, market sources there said.
About 1,400 head traded on a live and dressed basis, with live sales reported at $70.00, with a few at $71.00 for steers and $70.00 for heifers, according to USDA.
Sales for the week were pegged at 51,000 head near midday Thursday, USDA said. Much of this week's showlist reportedly had been sold or was close to being depleted, sources said.
The showlist for next week was seen steady with this week, but still containing a large number of unfinished cattle.
